---
title: "Do the reinforced AR 80.3 tandem's mass and wing loading stay within limits?"
---

{{< include _model.qmd >}}

```{python}
ENTRY_CEILING = 90.0   # s for this render, granted by the user
SOLVE_BUDGET = 15.0     # s for any one solve
PROBE_POOL = 200.0        # s granted for the probe
PROBE_SPENT = 0.0      # s the probe actually used

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Execute mass and flight limits evaluation for AR 80.3 tandem
# Divergence reinforcement dm_div = 71.7 kg from 2026-09-30-05
mb = tandem_mass_budget_analysis(dm_div=71.7)

m_empty = float(mb["m_empty"])
m_flight = float(mb["m_flight_dry"])
m_mtom_limit = float(mb["m_mtom_limit"])
ballast_max = float(mb["m_ballast_max"])

wl_flight = float(mb["wl_flight"])
wl_mtom = float(mb["wl_mtom"])
wl_limit = float(mb["wl_limit"])

v_stall_base = float(mb["v_stall_base"])
v_stall_flight = float(mb["v_stall_flight"])
v_stall_mtom = float(mb["v_stall_mtom"])

delta_v_stall = float(v_stall_flight - v_stall_base)
margin_mtom = float(m_mtom_limit - m_flight)
margin_wl = float(wl_limit - wl_mtom)
```

::: {.hero}
[`{python} f"{m_flight:.1f} kg"`]{.hero-value}
[pilot flight mass leaving 76.3 kg ballast margin within 565 kg MTOM and 52 kg/m² wing loading]{.hero-label}
:::

**Answer.** Yes. With both wings' [`{python} f"{mb['m_wings_dry']:.0f} kg"`]{.key} base structure and the [`{python} f"{mb['dm_div']:.1f} kg"`]{.key} divergence reinforcement from [aeroelastic sizing](2026-09-30-05-what-aspect-ratio-and-net-glide-ratio-are-achievable-with-an-aeroelast.qmd), empty mass reaches [`{python} f"{m_empty:.1f} kg"`]{.key}. Flight mass with pilot is [`{python} f"{m_flight:.1f} kg"`]{.key} ([`{python} f"{wl_flight:.1f} kg/m²"`]{.key} wing loading), leaving [`{python} f"{margin_mtom:.1f} kg"`]{.key} water ballast headroom beneath the [`{python} f"{m_mtom_limit:.0f} kg"`]{.key} MTOM limit (@fig-mass-budget). Stall speed rises from [`{python} f"{v_stall_base:.1f} km/h"`]{.key} to [`{python} f"{v_stall_flight:.1f} km/h"`]{.key} ([`{python} f"+{delta_v_stall:.1f} km/h"`]{.key}) at pilot flight mass and [`{python} f"{v_stall_mtom:.1f} km/h"`]{.key} at MTOM. At full MTOM, wing loading is [`{python} f"{wl_mtom:.1f} kg/m²"`]{.key}, staying [`{python} f"{margin_wl:.1f} kg/m²"`]{.key} under the [`{python} f"{wl_limit:.0f} kg/m²"`]{.key} ceiling.

```{python}
#| label: fig-mass-budget
#| fig-cap: "Mass buildup and flight envelope comparison of the AR 80.3 tandem against baseline limits, showing structural breakdown, wing loading, and stall speed."
fig, (ax1, ax2) = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(10, 4.2))

# Subplot 1: Stacked mass buildup comparison
configs = ["Baseline Monoplane", "AR 80.3 Tandem"]
fuse_tail = [mb["m_fuse_tail"], mb["m_fuse_tail"]]
wings = [mb["m_wings_dry"], mb["m_wings_dry"]]
reinf = [0.0, mb["dm_div"]]
pilot = [mb["m_pilot"], mb["m_pilot"]]
ballast = [mb["m_base_ballast"], mb["m_ballast_max"]]

bar_w = 0.5
ax1.bar(configs, fuse_tail, bar_w, label="Fuselage & Tail (197 kg)", color="#4682b4")
ax1.bar(configs, wings, bar_w, bottom=fuse_tail, label="Wing Dry Structure (140 kg)", color="#2e8b57")
ax1.bar(configs, reinf, bar_w, bottom=[f + w for f, w in zip(fuse_tail, wings)], label="Divergence Reinf. (+71.7 kg)", color="#dc143c")
ax1.bar(configs, pilot, bar_w, bottom=[f + w + r for f, w, r in zip(fuse_tail, wings, reinf)], label="Pilot (80 kg)", color="#e69f00")
ax1.bar(configs, ballast, bar_w, bottom=[f + w + r + p for f, w, r, p in zip(fuse_tail, wings, reinf, pilot)], label="Max Ballast", color="#56b4e9", alpha=0.6, hatch="//")

ax1.axhline(mb["m_mtom_limit"], color="black", ls="--", lw=1.5, label=f"MTOM limit ({mb['m_mtom_limit']:.0f} kg)")
ax1.set_ylabel("Aircraft Mass [kg]")
ax1.set_ylim(0, 620)
ax1.set_title("Aircraft Mass Buildup to MTOM")
ax1.grid(True, axis="y", alpha=0.3)
ax1.legend(loc="upper left", fontsize=7.2)

# Subplot 2: Wing loading and stall speed comparison
metrics = ["Flight WL\n[kg/m²]", "MTOM WL\n[kg/m²]", "Flight Vstall\n[km/h]", "MTOM Vstall\n[km/h]"]
base_vals = [mb["wl_base_flight"], mb["wl_base_mtom"], mb["v_stall_base"], mb["v_stall_base_mtom"]]
td_vals = [mb["wl_flight"], mb["wl_mtom"], mb["v_stall_flight"], mb["v_stall_mtom"]]

x = np.arange(len(metrics))
w2 = 0.35
r1 = ax2.bar(x - w2/2, base_vals, w2, label="Baseline", color="#4682b4", alpha=0.85)
r2 = ax2.bar(x + w2/2, td_vals, w2, label="AR 80.3 Tandem", color="#d95f02", alpha=0.85)

for bar in list(r1) + list(r2):
    yval = bar.get_height()
    ax2.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2.0, yval + 1.2, f"{yval:.1f}", ha="center", va="bottom", fontsize=8.0)

ax2.axhline(mb["wl_limit"], color="crimson", ls=":", lw=1.5, label=f"Max WL limit ({mb['wl_limit']:.0f} kg/m²)")
ax2.set_xticks(x)
ax2.set_xticklabels(metrics, fontsize=8.5)
ax2.set_ylabel("Value [kg/m² or km/h]")
ax2.set_ylim(0, 105)
ax2.set_title("Wing Loading & Stall Speed Comparison")
ax2.grid(True, axis="y", alpha=0.3)
ax2.legend(loc="upper left", fontsize=7.8)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```
